summary_source: Data Analyst and AI/ML Engineer with experience in data analysis, machine learning, predictive modeling, and Generative AI. Skilled in Python, SQL, Power BI, AWS, and LLM-based applications, with experience building anomaly detection, reporting, and RAG-based chatbot solutions that improve decision-making, compliance monitoring, and operational efficiency.

bullets.text: Built anomaly detection models (Isolation Forest), improving fraud detection accuracy by 10–12%
Reduced false positives by 12–15%, enhancing compliance monitoring efficiency
Processed 100K+ transactions using SQL and Python with RFM-based pipelines
Automated reporting workflows using Python and SQL, reducing manual effort by 40%
Analyzed 100K+ records using Python and SQL to extract actionable business insights
Developed Power BI dashboards for KPI tracking, performance monitoring, and executive reporting
Automated reporting pipelines, saving 10+ hours per week
Optimized SQL queries, improving execution time by 20%
Improved backend performance and database efficiency for faster data retrieval

projects.name: LLM-Based AI Chatbot
projects.stack: Python, Flask, LangChain, FAISS, Groq, MongoDB

bullets.text: Developed an AI-powered chatbot using LangChain, Groq Llama 3.3-70B, and a FAISS-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline for semantic document retrieval
Built a LangChain agent with custom retrieval and calculator tools, enabling context-aware question answering, mathematical computations, and multi-turn conversations
Designed and deployed Flask REST APIs, integrated MongoDB for persistent conversation history and session management, and implemented dynamic prompt construction using retrieved context
Developed ML models (Logistic Regression, SVM, Gradient Boosting)
Achieved 90-95% accuracy through feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning
Improved precision and recall using robust evaluation techniques, 0.72 ROC-AUC
Built churn prediction model with ~90% accuracy
Assessed performance using precision, recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC and identified key churn drivers to support targeted retention strategies
Designed interactive dashboards for KPI tracking, business insights and automated reporting workflows, saving weekly manual effort
